Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in Step 13 by incorrectly concluding that the 1800s (specifically 1808-1813) belong to the "18th century." This is a fundamental historical and mathematical error: the 18th century spans 1701–1800, while the 19th century spans 1801–1900. Despite having gathered multiple authoritative sources (Britannica, History.com, NPS) confirming the dates were in the early 1800s (1808-1813), the Planner failed to perform the basic conversion from year to century. Instead, it contradicted the ground truth ("nineteenth") and its own gathered evidence by stating the answer was the "18th century." This error was likely caused by a confusion between the "1800s" (the decade/century name) and the ordinal "18th century" (the specific time period 1701-1800).
